facts.business: Glen Industries Limited manufactures eco-friendly food packaging and foodservice products including thin-wall food containers, PLA straws, paper straws, paper cups, and thermoforming-based solutions for HoReCa, QSR, FMCG, retail, beverage, and dairy industries in India and export markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: New manufacturing facility in Howrah, West Bengal for Thermoforming and Paper Cup products

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management has reiterated an ambition to reach approximately Rs. 50,000 Lakhs in turnover

key_risks: Increase in crude oil prices compressing EBITDA margin
Increase in transit time due to disruption in Middle East
